Default_Recommendation: Use separate targets for >30% decline, absolute nadir bands, severe <25k, recovery, and monitoring actions.
Scientific_Rationale: Prevents one universal POS/NEG label from erasing severity and time course.
When_User_Input_Is_Required: No user input required now; final signoff before model freeze.

Default_Recommendation: Primary definition: moderate, generally dose-associated and reversible decline; retain both relative >30% decline and absolute nadir categories rather than forcing one threshold.
Scientific_Rationale: Source programs use different thresholds; preserving both supports harmonization without false equivalence.

Default_Recommendation: Restrict to rare severe abrupt cases, especially <25,000/µL and/or antibody/bleeding evidence; analyze as case series.
Scientific_Rationale: Current event count is too small for standard supervised classification.

Default_Recommendation: Keep the seven-gate clean-negative rule; no current candidate passes all gates.
Scientific_Rationale: Absence of reporting is not evidence of absence.
When_User_Input_Is_Required: Do not relax merely to balance classes.

Default_Recommendation: Use olezarsen/eplontersen as treatment-context comparators, not clean negatives.
Scientific_Rationale: Non-equivalent dose, targeting, study design, and residual platelet observations prevent clean-negative status.

Decision_Area: Human ex vivo ordinal response score
Default_Recommendation: Permit 0-3 scientist-derived score only for restricted proof-of-concept and sensitivity analyses; raw numeric values take priority whenever available.
Scientific_Rationale: Allows use of qualified qualitative evidence without misrepresenting it as raw data.

Default_Recommendation: Keep GPVI binding, P-selectin/PAC-1, platelet-leukocyte aggregates, PF4 binding, cytokines, and megakaryocyte endpoints separate; any composite is secondary.
Scientific_Rationale: Different assays represent different mechanisms and biological levels.
When_User_Input_Is_Required: Final target set review before Gustavo models.

Default_Recommendation: Maintain separate intended-pharmacology/control lane for ARC1779, BT200, factor XI ASOs, and anticoagulant aptamers.
Scientific_Rationale: Desired platelet/coagulation inhibition is not automatically toxicity.

Default_Recommendation: Keep disease-related platelet normalization as a therapeutic correction control, not a negative toxicity label.
Scientific_Rationale: Direction of platelet change and underlying disease context matter.

Default_Recommendation: Do not use numeric weights in final modeling until sensitivity analyses compare unweighted, tier-restricted, and confidence-weighted results.
Scientific_Rationale: Arbitrary weights could encode curator judgment as model truth.
When_User_Input_Is_Required: Review with Gustavo after first POC plan.

Default_Recommendation: Publish explicit NOT_REPORTED fields and continue source recovery; never infer purity from sequence or vendor/source.
Scientific_Rationale: Phase 2 asks for characterization information, but unavailable data must remain transparent.

Default_Recommendation: No final dataset freeze until Oscar passes relational QA, licenses are approved, repository/persistent ID are selected, and German signs every model-eligible subset.
Scientific_Rationale: Prevents provisional evidence from being mistaken for a validated public model dataset.
When_User_Input_Is_Required: User signoff required only at final freeze.
